product_overview: Block Blast Pro is an addictive cross-platform mobile block puzzle game inspired by the classic Block Blast! It features engaging block placement mechanics, smooth drag-and-drop controls, progressive difficulty, and a variety of game modes. Built with React Native and Expo, the game offers a modern UI/UX, rich animations, social features, and a comprehensive monetization strategy.
core_goals: Deliver a smooth and engaging block puzzle gameplay experience with intuitive drag-and-drop controls and animations.
Implement progressive difficulty with varied block shapes and challenging game modes to keep players engaged.
Provide social features such as leaderboards, achievements, and daily challenges to enhance player retention.
Support monetization through ads, in-app purchases, and premium subscriptions without compromising user experience.
Ensure high performance, stability, and crash-free gameplay leveraging React Native Reanimated and optimized component management.
Track user behavior and app performance using Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics for ongoing improvements.
key_features: Classic 8x8 grid and Chaos 10x10 grid game modes with different hand piece counts and difficulty.
Drag-and-drop block placement with smooth animations using React Native Reanimated and Gesture Handler.
Line-breaking and combo scoring mechanics for advanced gameplay depth.
AdMob integration offering banner, interstitial, and rewarded video ads strategically placed.
In-app purchases including remove ads option, power-up packs, premium themes, and subscriptions.
Social features including local leaderboards, achievement tracking, social sharing, and daily challenges.
Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics integration for analytics and crash reporting.
Optimized game components with useAnimatedReaction hooks to fix crashes and improve rendering efficiency.
user_flow_summary: Player launches the app and lands on the main menu with access to game modes, leaderboards, and settings.
Player selects a game mode (Classic or Chaos) and enters the game screen displaying the grid and hand pieces.
Player drags and drops blocks onto the grid, triggering line breaks, combos, and score updates.
Ads are shown based on session events: banners during gameplay, interstitials between games, rewarded ads for power-ups.
Players can access premium features or remove ads via the in-app purchase store.
Players view achievements, daily challenges, and leaderboards from the social menu.
Player session data and gameplay events are tracked and sent to Firebase Analytics for analysis.
validation_criteria: All critical game components render without runtime crashes or errors across supported devices.
Drag-and-drop interactions respond smoothly with appropriate animated feedback.
Score calculations for line breaks and combos are accurate and consistent.
Ad placements are correctly integrated and do not disrupt gameplay flow.
In-app purchases process successfully and unlock corresponding content/features.
Social features reflect correct data for leaderboards and achievements, updating in real-time.
Firebase Analytics events are correctly logged and crash reports captured and addressed.
Performance benchmarks meet predefined standards ensuring stable 60fps gameplay on target devices.

features.name: React Native Reanimated Crash Fix
features.description: Fixed SIGSEGV crash caused by improper access to shared values during component render. Replaced direct .value access in useEffect hooks and component render with useAnimatedReaction hooks.

features.name: Enhanced Game Component Improvements
features.description: Improved EnhancedGame component by fixing useEffect dependency arrays and removing direct shared value access during render. Added proper game service integration and modal state management.

features.name: Block Grid Rendering Optimization
features.description: Optimized BlockGrid component rendering by using useAnimatedReaction instead of direct shared value access. Fixed board length and block elements state management.

features.name: Hand Pieces State Management
features.description: Fixed HandPieces component by replacing direct hand.value.length access with proper state management using useAnimatedReaction hooks.

features.name: Game Component Stability
features.description: Improved Game component stability by fixing useEffect dependencies and removing direct shared value access during component initialization.
